caseName: Commissioner v. Milwaukee & Suburban Transport Corp.
caseNameFull: Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. Milwaukee & Suburban Transport Corp.
attorneys: Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Oberdorfer, Harry Baum and Joseph Kovner for petitioner., Richard R. Teschner and Warren W. Browning for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded in light of American Automobile Association v. United States, ante, p. 687, and United States v. Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc., 366 U. S. 380.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents.
